O.outcome_detail: WWC pooled seven outcomes in the knowledge, attitudes, and values domain

cells.quote: The domain average effect size was 0.36 and the improvement index "+14 percentile points, with a range of +3 to +30 percentile points across findings." "When the WWC aggregated all seven outcomes the average effect size was substantively important (greater than 0.25). So the WWC rated the program as having potentially positive effects in the knowledge, attitudes, and values domain."
